doc.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07

title: Decatur Street crowds, celebrities and floor shows
summary: Allen asks who came there; De De and Billie describe sailors, celebrities and shows with dancers like Annabella.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: Who hung around Decatur Street in those days? Would they be sailors, Filipinos?
You were saying, it was sort of like the biary there on Decatur Street?
In other words, you know, people all walk alive, you know, some old ones, young ones, some walking ships, you know, all walks alive in other words, you know.
Some celebrities every once in a while, you said.
Nine and then celebrities come true, you know.
And what would the celebrities do when they were there?

Well they'd come, they'd tip the band, sit on there, I guess, you know, they'd come for a party of four, A party of four, four, four, I would quite nicely give them a special treatment, you know what I mean? You know, set up table and all like that, you know. They'd stay in the car, just see, and we had those flow shows on, you know. They'd come in and see a show, do shows, and then pull out. I mean, they'd come in and see a show.
Well we had a show down there on Decatur Street, we had a show. That's a small one there. Yeah, we had a girl, she's in New York now. She's a little Jamaica girl.
Annabella, she used to do the banana wicker. And she was really good, oh she was really good at that.
Well she had a bone in the body, you know. All that too.
And I had them run across her in Coney Island, I didn't know in New York. We had them run across her. She said, well look at Billy and GD. And we had some fun around in Coney Island.
She was, you had dancers in there, huh? Yeah.
On shows, sometimes on the air.

No, we didn't have no strips, because this was all color, we didn't have no strips in that time. We had Shake Banana wicker, you know. They'd dance, you know, with the... Comedy, comedy sketch, and everything like that. Comedy sketch, and everything like that. And boy, she looked like she had a bone in her body. She just about, that high. Little bit of thing. Yeah. Four feet high or something like that. Yeah, just about like that. Little bit of thing. And they had comedy too, huh? Yeah. Yeah, you know, sketches, you know, like, uh, and Man and the Ministers, you know. Jokes and stuff like that. Everybody's carrying on everything. Make up a show, make a gathering. We play, I play the show, on the half every hour.
Six and sometimes that's a good thing.
Yeah. stuff like killer. Plenty of work.
